t: Memo Re Nee Ts Meng & Lee Ping Su

pages.en:
CHIN
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
MUNICIPAL POLICE
D. REGISTRY
File No. D. 505
12. 9. 29.
September 10, 1929.

I beg to report that at 5.30 p.m. September 8, Agent
No. 4 Nee Ts Meng(尼子萌) of the Intelligence Section was
arrested on Tsing Yuen Road, Chapei, by a member of the 6th
District Kuomintang Branch and was subsequently detained for
the night at the 5th District Police Station, Chapei, on a
charge of representing himself to be a reporter of the Min Kuo
Pao under the assumed name of Lee Ping Su(李品書). Agent
No. 4 used this device on former occasions to assist him to
attend labour union meetings and Kuomintang meetings which
otherwise he could not do.

In order to secure his release, D.S.I. Papp and C.D.S.I.
Koo Wei Tsing made representations at the Public Safety Bureau
at 10 a.m. September 9. On obtaining Col. Yuan Liang's
consent for his release, D.S.I. Papp and C.D.S.I. Koo proceeded
to the 5th District Police Station, Chapei, where difficulties
were encountered owing to the fact that Agent No. 4 was arrested
by a member of the 6th District Kuomintang Branch and to secure
his release their permission had also to be obtained. This
difficulty was complicated by the fact that the 6th District
Kuomintang Branch had referred the matter to the Kuomintang
Headquarters for decision. To overcome these obstacles a
representative of the 6th District Kuomintang Branch and one
from the Kuomintang Headquarters were summoned by the
Inspector in charge of the 5th District Police Station and
after consultation with them they agreed to release Agent No. 4
on the condition that the man will be returned to them if
required by their headquarters. It being a face saving device,
D.S.I. Papp and C.D.S.I. Koo gave a written guarantee on the
latter's visiting card to this effect. D.S.I. Papp had also to
promise that the Min Kuo Pao's name will not be used in the
future before Agent No. 4 was released. The agent was freed at
12.45 p.m. September 9.
pages.zh:
金
（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
工部局警务处
D. 登记处
档案号 D. 505
1929年9月12日。
1929年9月10日。

谨报告，9月8日下午5时30分，情报科第4号探员尼子萌（Nee Ts Meng）在闸北清源路被国民党第六区党部一名成员逮捕，随后因涉嫌冒用李品书（Lee Ping Su）之名自称是《民国报》记者，而被拘押于闸北第五区警察分局过夜。第4号探员以往曾使用此手段，以便参加他 otherwise 无法参加的工会会议和国民党会议。

为争取其获释，副督察长帕普（Papp）与助理副督察长顾伟清（Koo Wei Tsing）于9月9日上午10时向公安局提出交涉。在获得袁良上校同意释放后，副督察长帕普与助理副督察长顾伟清前往闸北第五区警察分局，但因第4号探员系由国民党第六区党部成员逮捕，需获得该方许可方可释放，故遇到阻碍。由于国民党第六区党部已将此事上报国民党总部候决，这一困难更为复杂。为克服这些障碍，第五区警察分局主管巡官召来了国民党第六区党部的一名代表及国民党总部的一名代表，经与他们协商，他们同意释放第4号探员，条件是一旦其总部要求，须将该人交还。鉴于这是一种顾全面子的做法，副督察长帕普与助理副督察长顾伟清在后者名片上出具了书面保证，承诺照办。在第4号探员获释前，副督察长帕普还须承诺今后不再使用《民国报》之名。该探员于9月9日中午12时45分获释。

pages.en:
File No.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
- 2 -
At 11.50 p.m. September 9, C.D.S.I. Koo Wei Tsing explained
the matter to Chen Te-tseng, Chief Editor of the Min Kuo Pao.
In return Chen Te-tseng requested C.D.S.I. Koo to give him a
letter promising that the name of the Min Kuo Pao will not be
used by the Intelligence Section agents in the future.
I respectfully submit that should this request be refused,
the difficulties in negotiation in cases of a similar nature
will be greatly enhanced.
This case illustrates clearly the enmity of the
Kuomintang towards the Council and that it will stop at
nothing to cause the S.M.P. embarrassment.

E. Papp
D. S. I.

A/ D. C. I.

I have given instructions to members
of the staff to ignore Chen Te-tseng &
suggest that any communication from
him or the Kuomintang on the matter
be consigned to the W.P.B.
HR

d.c.l.
He was attending a Labour
Union meeting. I am afraid
it is pure spite instigated
by lack of discretion in letting
The Labour Union people all
know.
Rivers
11/9    A/D.C.I.

（左侧手写批注：no, he is an agent. must take his chances he was working in the interests of the public & there is no question of motive. C.I.）

（左下角手写批注：An agent must take his chances - RWM SEP 11 1929）
pages.zh:
档案号
（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
- 2 -
9月9日晚11时50分，助理副督察长顾伟清向《民国报》总编辑陈德征解释了此事。作为回应，陈德征要求助理副督察长顾伟清给他一封函件，承诺情报科探员今后不再使用《民国报》之名。
卑职认为，若拒绝此请求，今后在处理类似案件时的谈判难度将大大增加。
本案清楚地表明了国民党对工部局的敌意，以及其为使上海公共租界警务处陷入尴尬境地而不择手段的态度。

E. 帕普
副督察长

代 助理总监

我已指示下属人员无视陈德征，并建议将其或国民党就此事宜发出的任何信函转交至西捕房。
HR

d.c.l.
他当时正在参加一次工会会议。我担心这纯粹是出于恶意，起因是在让工会人士知晓此事时缺乏谨慎。
里弗斯
9月11日    代助理总监

（左侧手写批注：不，他是一名探员。必须承担风险。他是为了公众利益而工作，不存在动机问题。刑事侦缉处处长。）

（左下角手写批注：探员必须承担风险 - RWM 1929年9月11日）
